title: Wayseeking Mind
speaker: Joden Bob Rose
summary: Joden Bob Rose shares their personal journey as a path to discovering the importance of meditation and continuous practice in Zen Buddhism. Through experiences such as poetry, work, environmental conservation, farming, and community involvement, they came to understand the value of being present, trusting one's instincts, and letting go of regrets. By sharing their own story and reflecting on their Soto Zen practice, Joden invites listeners to recognize where they are in their own journey and cultivate a steady and continuous practice.
